description:
AfroTech is big. Fast. Loud. Full of opportunity.
You may only get a few minutes with a recruiter, mentor, founder, or industry leader — and in a conference this large, being impressive isn’t always enough. You also have to be memorable.
In this interactive session presented by Howard University’s Center for Digital Business and North Carolina A&T State University’s Willie A. Using AI-powered feedback through PitchVantage, you’ll test a response, see how it lands, decide what feedback is useful, and try it again. Along the way, we’ll talk about what makes someone memorable in a professional setting: clarity, specificity, confidence, and sounding like an actual person.
You’ll leave with a stronger introduction, better instincts for high-stakes conversations, and a practical way to use AI to prepare for interviews, networking, presentations, and other moments when how you communicate matters.

Join PwC professionals, Bryce Badger, Jaida Day and Tevin Slaughter, for a conversation on career readiness, financial confidence, and continuous learning as technology evolves. You’ll hear real experiences and gain practical ideas to help you build your professional and personal foundation and move forward with greater clarity and confidence.

In this session, Keith walks through exactly how he did it, from idea to launch. Students will leave with a clear look at his process, the tools he used, and practical steps to build their own AI-powered project.

title: Lab to Launch: Pitch Your Way In Presented by Texas Southern University

speakers.name: Michelle John

speakers.name: Lawrence Miller

description:
In this fast-paced, hands-on session hosted by Texas Southern University, you will team up with students from other schools, use a real university research capability, and pair it with an actual Houston problem. With AI tools and live coaching from recruiters and industry leaders, your team will shape a startup idea and pitch it for prizes. No experience, preparation, or STEM background needed.
How it works (90 minutes):
Join a pod (5 min). Sit with 6 to 8 students; your table becomes your team. Your team receives a card describing one Texas Southern research capability, such as flight simulators or drones that map storm damage, and a Houston problem it could help solve.
Hear from the experts (30 min). A panel conversation with leaders in research commercialization, corporate innovation, and startups on how ideas become companies, followed by audience questions.
Build your idea (30 min). Using a simple one-page worksheet, your team decides who has the problem, what you would build, and why it wins. You can use AI tools on your phone to research, and coaches will visit your table.
Pitch (17 min). Every team shares a one-sentence pitch. Judges then pick 4 to 5 finalist teams to give a 60 second pitch on stage and get live feedback.
Win and connect (8 min). Awards in four categories, including a crowd favorite chosen by the room, followed by networking.
What to bring: a charged phone or laptop. Everything else, including the research cards and worksheets, is provided.
Who it serves: This session is designed for career-focused students as well as aspiring founders, emphasizing the skills employers value most: pitching, problem solving, teamwork, and effective use of artificial intelligence.
What you walk away with:
Face time with recruiters and industry leaders who coach and judge your work
Hands-on practice in skills employers want: pitching, problem solving, teamwork, and using AI
Who it serves: Students attending AfroTech U from any college or university. The session is open to all AfroTech U attendees. This session is designed for career-focused students as well as aspiring founders, emphasizing the skills employers value most: pitching, problem solving, teamwork, and effective use of artificial intelligence.
Why it matters: Black founders may lack access to the resources that turn ideas into companies, such as labs, research expertise, data, mentors, and paths to market. Universities, especially HBCUs like Texas Southern, already have many of these resources. This session shows students how to find and use them while they are still in school.

In this session, CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER® professional Kofo Akosile will explore how holistic financial planning can help you move from simply reacting to life's uncertainty to responding with confidence. You'll walk away with practical strategies to make more informed financial decisions, align your money with the life you're building, and create a plan that evolves alongside your goals. Because true wealth isn't measured by what you earn, it's measured by the freedom and confidence to navigate whatever comes next.

speakers.name: Dr. Nicole Murray

speakers.company: Durham Region Center for Cognitive Health

description:
AI won’t replace your judgment, but it may be eroding it.
As AI becomes embedded in everyday decision-making, leaders are offloading more cognitive work than they realize, introducing a new and largely unexamined risk to performance.
Dr. Murray, a neuropsychologist working at the intersection of brain science and executive function, will help attendees understand how AI is reshaping cognition and what leaders must recognize to remain effective.
This focus is not about rejecting AI. It’s about recognizing the cognitive tradeoffs and knowing where reliance becomes risk.

description: A data leader from DoorDash and a design leader from Deliveroo (a DASH company) in conversation about building AI that people actually use. Felicia Williams (Senior Director, Product Design, Deliveroo) and Alyssa Wisdom (Director, Analytics, DoorDash) discuss the decisions behind shipped AI — what they chose not to build, where the data led them, and who gets considered when those calls are made. Includes an exploration of Ask DoorDash from both disciplines and an audience Q&A.

description:
Salesforce invites you to dive headfirst into the newest technology with our hands-on bootcamp focused on Building Your Agentic Future. This immersive 4-hour, bring-your-own-laptop session is your launchpad into the Salesforce ecosystem and the latest in artificial intelligence.
Whether you are new to tech or looking to rapidly expand your skill set, this session is designed to empower you with the knowledge and practical experience needed to thrive in an AI-driven world. During this interactive bootcamp, you’ll learn to:
Discover the Salesforce Ecosystem: Learn exactly what Salesforce does and learn how to leverage resources. You'll earn your very first Trailhead badges right in the room!
Explore Headless 360 & The Future of AI: Dive into the very latest in Salesforce technology by building your own agent through conversation with Headless 360, and get an exclusive look at the current landscape and exciting future of AI at Salesforce.
This isn't just about learning; it's about doing. By mastering these foundational AI and Salesforce concepts, you are positioning yourself at the forefront of the tech industry. Our trainers will ensure you leave with actionable next steps for your career growth.
Bring your laptop, bring your ambition, and get ready to build your agentic future! Space is limited, so arrive early and power up!

title: Building a Successful Tech Career in Uncertain Times
description: Tech careers are not built on coding skills alone. This session makes the hidden rules of hiring and opportunity more visible for students and early-career professionals, especially those without mentors, industry connections, or a clear roadmap. In a market shaped by AI, layoffs, and tougher competition, attendees learn how to build a skill stack, create proof of work, build relationships, increase visibility, and leave with a 12-month action plan.

Constant, & Millicent Auma explore how AI is reshaping the threat landscape and how financial institutions are using AI to fight back. Learn how emerging technologies are changing fraud, trust, and wealth protection, and what individuals and organizations can do to stay secure in an increasingly AI-powered world.

title: Giving AI Agents Access Without Giving Away the Keys Presented by Nationwide
description: As AI agents and automated services request access to systems on their own, identity and access management has become the front line of enterprise security. Nationwide's VP of Cybersecurity Platforms breaks down how identity teams extend access controls beyond employees to service accounts and autonomous tools.

title: Remote Monitoring & Digital Therapeutics
description: Remote patient monitoring and digital therapeutics are extending care beyond traditional clinical settings and creating new models for continuous, data-driven intervention. Dr. Charles DeShazer provides a practical framework for implementation across cardiometabolic and behavioral health conditions, covering patient selection, workflow integration, data governance, and how to distinguish FDA-regulated digital therapeutics from consumer wellness tools.

title: Access to Care Roundtable Presented by NAACP
description:
Clinical research still doesn't reach the communities it's supposed to serve. If you're working to change that, from trial design to community trust, this is your table.
Facilitator: Dr. Chris Pernell, Health Equity Director at NAACP

title: Book Signing with Rachel Rodgers
Executive Innovation RoundTable Presented by Intuit

speakers.name: Erica Terry Derryck
speakers.title: Vice President, Global Communications | Global Business Solutions Group

description:
CEOs and senior leaders, off the record. The kind of conversation that only happens when there are no cameras and everyone at the table has been in the chair.
Facilitator:
Erica Terry Derryck, VP Global Communications, Global Business Solutions Group at Intuit
Reggie Marable: Chief Customer Officer at Sierra

title: Bridging the AI Divide: How Cisco Builds Trust Through Responsible AI and Reverse Mentorship Presented by Cisco
locationLabel: Product & Innovation Stage (Exhibit Hall C&D (1st Floor))

speakers.name: Christelle Mombo-Zigah
speakers.title: Global Strategy and Planning in AI Infrastructure

description: As AI reshapes the tech landscape, industry leaders are faced with two core challenges: governing powerful new technology and ensuring that the workforce is ready to use it inclusively. In this 20-minute session, we break down Cisco’s "Trustworthy AI by Design" approach. We will explore how our Responsible AI Framework establishes the necessary guardrails for transparency and fairness, and how our Cisco AI Mentorship Program (CAMP) uses reverse mentorship to bridge the gap between executive strategy and innovation. Join us to learn how to move beyond policy to build real, scalable, and trustworthy AI practices.

title: Getting Discovered in the LinkedIn Feed Presented by LinkedIn
description: With more information, advice, and opportunity at our fingertips than ever, the challenge is figuring out what actually matters for your career. In this Learning Lab, LinkedIn leaders will take attendees behind the scenes of the LinkedIn Feed to explore how AI, personalization, and recommendation systems connect professionals with relevant ideas and people. Attendees will learn how LinkedIn thinks about what gets surfaced and why, how the Feed is evolving to better understand their interests, and what that means for how they learn, build professional relationships, and discover new opportunities.

title: Building Fairness Into the Data Supply Chain
description: Bias in clinical AI can begin before training, embedded in decisions about missing data, labels, and success metrics. Waverly Rose Brim explores how strong overall AI model performance can mask harm to Black patients and the underinsured. Through a hands-on, fairness-aware audit workflow using real CDC data, she guides attendees in testing the assumptions built into a clinical pipeline. Together, you’ll examine how upstream modeling choices change who qualifies for treatment and search for hidden harm in overlooked subgroups. You’ll leave with a repeatable audit method and a go/no-go deployment checklist. Bring your laptop to participate. NVIDIA has partnered with Brim to provide complimentary access codes for select NVIDIA Deep Learning Institute courses, helping attendees continue learning beyond the workshop.

title: AI Video Creation Demo with King Willonius
locationLabel: Product & Innovation Stage (Exhibit Hall C&D (1st Floor))
description: King Willonius takes input from the room and builds a video live. The audience calls out words, vibes, and references, and he feeds them into his AI video workflow on screen, narrating every decision as he goes. Before he went viral, he was making an AI film every week, including King Kendrick. This demo makes the method transparent: what a good prompt actually looks like, what the tools do with it, and what King Willonius adds that the AI can't.

title: From Apple to AI
locationLabel: AfroTech Authors Pavilion Presented by Penguin Random House
description: Denise Young Smith on 20+ years at Apple and what inclusion means as technology and AI change who gets to build.

title: The Future of Work Has No Borders
description: Geography used to define opportunity. Carrol Chang, CEO of Andela, brings a global lens to that shift. Andela's developers have operated in distributed environments out of necessity for years, adapting and upskilling long before distributed work became a Silicon Valley talking point. This session explores how leading organizations are rethinking hiring and workforce strategy in an AI-first world.

title: From Bias Evaluation to Trustworthy Healthcare AI Implementation

speakers.name: Dr. Tiffani Bright
speakers.title: Co-Director, Center for Artificial Intelligence Research and Education Assistant Professor of Computational Biomedicine, Cedars-Sinai Medical Center

description: AI tools are moving from pilot to deployment across healthcare, and the stakes around bias, governance, and oversight are no longer theoretical. Dr. Tiffani J. Bright provides a practical roadmap for implementing trustworthy AI, covering how to evaluate algorithmic bias, assess data representativeness, build governance structures, and sustain continuous monitoring.  Attendees leave with concrete strategies for deploying equitable, high-performing AI in real clinical settings.

title: Trust, Security, and the Rise of Robots
description: When software can move, mistakes cause real harm. As robots and autonomous systems enter workplaces and public spaces, old security models fail. This session examines why trust breaks down and what must change before consequences scale.

title: The Battle of Agentic AI: Securing vs. Security Usage Presented by PwC
description: This session is intended to provide insights into key security considerations for organizations and individuals using agentic AI, explore effective use cases and potential benefits of adopting agentic AI within CISO organizations and security departments, and address additional AI-related security measures to help safeguard enterprises.

title: Beyond the Yard: Career Lessons Across Generations
description:
How have technology, career opportunities, and the HBCU experience evolved across generations—and what can today's students and alumni learn from one another?
Across Generations brings together Howard University alumnus Andrew Lindsay, Corporate Vice President of Cloud and AI Platforms Business Development at Microsoft, and Meliah Bell, a senior Computer Information Systems major at Howard University, for an engaging intergenerational conversation about navigating careers, embracing innovation, and creating opportunities in an ever-changing world.
A member of Howard's Board of Trustees and co-founder of its Center for Digital Business, Lindsay brings decades of leadership experience across technology, business, and public service. Bell offers the perspective of an emerging technology professional, drawing on her experiences at PwC, HP, and Howard's Center for Digital Business.
Together, they'll reflect on lessons learned, shifting expectations, and the enduring value of the HBCU experience in preparing the next generation of leaders.

title: How I’d Hack You (and How to Stop Me)
description: If you have ever used public WiFi, reused a password, or clicked a link that felt slightly off, you are already a target. This session breaks down three real cyberattacks: a fake public WiFi network, a password exposed in a data breach, and a spoofed AfroTech login page. Security engineer Lamarr Henry walks through how each attack works and exactly what you can do to stop it. No jargon required.

title: Mandatory AI Agent Training for Executive Leaders
description: Most leaders are still using AI one question at a time. In this hands-on session, Brandon Z. Hoff, Chief AI Officer of RUDI AI, shows you how to move past one-off prompts and build AI systems that handle entire processes, from research to finished work. Follow along as he walks through real-world examples step by step, then put it into practice yourself. You’ll leave with a working approach you can bring back to your team and use right away.

title: Building Products Rooted in Real Community Needs
locationLabel: Product & Innovation Stage (Exhibit Hall C&D (1st Floor))
description: Dave Salvant did not set out to disrupt an industry. He walked into barbershops, listened, and built what was missing. As co-founder of SQUIRE, he turned a deeply cultural community space into a $750M platform serving barbers nationwide. This session, including a live product demo, shows what happens when a founder builds from lived experience instead of market research. Come see how trust becomes a competitive moat.

title: Women & the Workforce: Laws of Success in Leadership
locationLabel: AfroTech Authors Pavilion Presented by Penguin Random House
description: Two former CEOs and top executives (HBO, Time Inc.) on how Black women build confidence and the strategies to reach the C-suite.

speakers.name: Candice Coletrane
speakers.title: Executive Director - ISG Product Release Operations

speakers.name: Benjamin Bennett
speakers.title: Executive Director - ISG Operations and Transformation

AI is moving fast. The question is whether it's moving in a direction that actually works for the people it's supposed to serve. A conversation about building AI that centers real communities, not just efficiency metrics.
Facilitators:

Benjamin Bennett: Executive Director, ISG Operations & Transformation at Lenovo

title: How Can Technology Help Us Better Navigate Our Health, And How We Do It Well? Presented by Genentech
locationLabel: Product & Innovation Stage (Exhibit Hall C&D (1st Floor))

speakers.name: Caroline De Marco
speakers.title: Community Impact Ambassador, Population Health Center of Excellence, Genentech

description:
A conversation about what it takes to do it well — moving past whether technology can help to how technology and thoughtful design actually improve the way people access, understand and navigate health.
The panel will be a 30-minute conversation exploring how technology can help people find, understand and use health information. The discussion will focus on access and understanding, navigation and trust, and the role of human connection.

title: The C-Suite Guide to Innovation and Responsible AI

speakers.name: Brian Tippens
speakers.title: Senior Vice President and Chief Social Impact & Sustainability Officer

description: Inclusion, accessibility, and equity must be designed into AI systems from the start. In this session, Brian Tippens, SVP and Chief Social Impact Officer at Cisco, shares how organizations move beyond policy commitments to build AI that expands economic mobility at scale. Drawing on Fortune 100 and community impact experience, Tippens delivers a direct case for what responsible AI looks like in practice.

title: The Intersection of Media, Faith, and Storytelling
locationLabel: AfroTech Authors Pavilion Presented by Penguin Random House

speakers.name: Albaner C. Eugene Jr.
speakers.title: Founder and President of ACE Productions and Let’s Move, and author of Momentum

description: Filmmaker, creative director, and entrepreneur Albaner Eugene on building a business where media, faith, and storytelling meet.

title: Bad Data Is Costing Black Lives

speakers.name: Dr. Uché Blackstock
speakers.title: Founder & CEO, Advancing Health Equity; Author, Legacy: A Black Physician Reckons with Racism in Medicine, New York Times Bestseller

speakers.name: Dr. Charles R. Rogers
speakers.title: Founder & Chief Advisor, Rogers Solutions Group; Founder & President, Colorectal Cancer Equity Foundation

speakers.name: Segun Oduolowu
speakers.title: Emmy Award-winning broadcast journalist & Communications Specialist

description: Health disparities are too often blamed on biology. The data tells a different story. Dr. Uché Blackstock and Dr. Charles R. Rogers examine the origins of data inequities, how they persist, and what it takes to dismantle them. From fragmented clinical records to public health reporting gaps, biased data delays diagnoses and misallocates resources. This session makes the case for health systems designed around transparency and equity.

title: Book Signing with Nicole Dove
Building Your Agentic Future Presented by Salesforce #2
description:
Salesforce invites you to dive headfirst into the newest technology with our hands-on bootcamp focused on Building Your Agentic Future. This immersive 4-hour, bring-your-own-laptop session is your launchpad into the Salesforce ecosystem and the latest in artificial intelligence.
Whether you are new to tech or looking to rapidly expand your skill set, this session is designed to empower you with the knowledge and practical experience needed to thrive in an AI-driven world. During this interactive bootcamp, you’ll learn to:
Discover the Salesforce Ecosystem: Learn exactly what Salesforce does and learn how to leverage resources. You'll earn your very first Trailhead badges right in the room!
Explore Headless 360 & The Future of AI: Dive into the very latest in Salesforce technology by building your own agent through conversation with Headless 360, and get an exclusive look at the current landscape and exciting future of AI at Salesforce.
This isn't just about learning; it's about doing. By mastering these foundational AI and Salesforce concepts, you are positioning yourself at the forefront of the tech industry. Our trainers will ensure you leave with actionable next steps for your career growth.
Bring your laptop, bring your ambition, and get ready to build your agentic future! Space is limited, so arrive early and power up!

title: Executive Lunch
Experience Required. Opportunity Needed. Presented by Apple
locationLabel: Product & Innovation Stage (Exhibit Hall C&D (1st Floor))

speakers.name: Korri Jackson
speakers.title: Senior Program Manager, Environment, Policy and Social Initiatives

description: How do you get experience when you need experience to get hired? For early talent, that question opens a bigger conversation about access, opportunity, and how employers recognize potential. Learn more about how Apple is supporting PROPEL Center to explore challenges as a new model for talent development and discovery, connecting students with real problems, industry feedback, and relationships that can help launch careers. Come hear from HBCU students who won first place winners in Propel Center’s 2025 HBCU Innovation Challenge competition in Austin, TX in conversation with Apple and Propel Center.

title: Beyond Prompting: Putting AI Agents to Work Presented by Microsoft

speakers.name: Chris Smellie
speakers.title: Director of Product Marketing for Copilot Frontier

description:
AI is moving beyond answering questions. Autonomous agents can carry work forward toward a goal, with people setting the direction and deciding when to step in. Knowing how to prompt is only the starting point. The next advantage is knowing what to delegate, how to define "done," and where your judgment matters most.
This Learning Lab looks at how autonomous AI agents are changing the way work gets done. We'll walk through a real workflow in Copilot Autopilot to show what was delegated, where human judgment stayed essential, and what changed as a result. We'll also explore why framing the right problem and evaluating the result are becoming core career skills.
You'll leave with three things you can use Monday: one recurring task to delegate, a clear definition of success, and a checkpoint that keeps you in control.

title: Legacy Is a Business Strategy
locationLabel: AfroTech Authors Pavilion Presented by Penguin Random House
description: Three leaders on building institutions, wealth, and cultures designed to outlive their founders.

title: HealthStack Luncheon
Work After AI: What the Data Shows and How to Stay Ahead
description: Dr. Andrew Forde leads AI research at KPMG, where he tracks how AI is reshaping industries, roles, and career paths across client organizations worldwide. In this session, he brings the data: where work is changing fastest, which skills and functions are gaining value, and what professionals can do right now to position themselves ahead of a labor market being rewritten in real time.

title: Be the Human in the Loop: Using Skills and Agents to Level Up Your Career Presented by Salesforce
description: AI agents aren't just for engineers. Salesforce Product Marketing Director Monica Bowie, a non-engineer, built an AI skill that started with 1,700 sellers and is now available to all 60k sellers globally. In this 20-minute lightning session, she shares the exact method to creating agents that anyone can use: three questions to spot work worth automating, a four-part recipe to build it without code, and a simple way to prove it worked. Join Monica to see a tangible application of humans in the loop that you can immediately apply to your own role as you build your agentic future.

title: Rethinking Income with Andrew Yang

speakers.name: Will Lucas
speakers.title: Brand Manager
speakers.company: AfroTech and Black Tech Green Money

description: As AI and automation reshape industries at unprecedented speed, leaders across business and government are rethinking the future of work and economic stability. In this executive-stage fireside chat, Andrew Yang explores the growing conversation around Universal Basic Income, workforce disruption, entrepreneurship, and financial resilience in an AI-driven economy. The discussion focuses on practical solutions, long-term thinking, and how innovation can create broader opportunities in a rapidly changing world.

title: AI, Homeownership, and Generational Wealth Presented by Rocket
locationLabel: Product & Innovation Stage (Exhibit Hall C&D (1st Floor))
description:
A mortgage isn't a document. It's 1.5 million documents a month, nearly a billion data points a year, and a regulatory obligation to be right every time. Every hour of human work in that pipeline gets priced into a fee the buyer pays in cash at closing. Rocket rebuilt origination as a data problem: 10+ petabytes of proprietary data, roughly 70% of monthly documents auto-identified, more than a million team-member hours out of the process.
Then Rocket pointed the same data at the friction before anyone applies the wasted journey. Reaching people when they're genuinely ready cut third-party lead spend 87%. Same data asset. Two kinds of friction. Both priced into what a buyer pays. Papanii Okai, EVP of Engineering, and Kelly Buchanan Spillers, VP of Brand and Product Marketing, walk both halves: where the hours were, what it takes to automate inside a regulated process, why a system that already knows your file feels more human rather than less, and where the savings land. Homeownership is how most families build wealth. The cost of getting in is the gate.

title: Still in the Room
locationLabel: AfroTech Authors Pavilion Presented by Penguin Random House
description: The former CEO of TLC Beatrice on staying sharp in business decades into a career, and why longevity is a leadership strategy.

title: The Beats Blueprint: Building the World Around the Product Presented by Apple

speakers.name: Alexis Johnson
speakers.title: Head of Social Impact - Beats by Dre

description: Twenty years ago, Beats changed the way the world thinks about sound, and it's kept the culture on speaker ever since. In this session, members of Beats' brand and sports marketing team pull back the curtain on the strategy behind two decades of staying power — from bold campaigns and iconic talent partnerships to the custom drops that turn products into cultural moments. Hear how Beats builds worlds around every launch, transforms "everyday" categories into cultural statements, and partners with talent to tell stories audiences can't get anywhere else. Whether you're building a brand, a following, or a legacy, this conversation is your blueprint for staying relevant without losing who you are.

title: The Intersection of Entertainment, Technology, & Storytelling
description:
The fireside chat brings together Howard University alumna and Disney executive Daniell McIntosh and current Howard student Naima Whitted for a discussion about career development and the intersection of entertainment, technology, and storytelling.
The conversation will explore Danielle’s professional journey, how technology is changing the way entertainment reaches audiences, and the business considerations involved in bringing stories to consumers. Through the conversation, attendees will gain insight ion the relationship between content creation and distribution, as well as the skills and experiences that can help prepare emerging professionals for technology careers in the entertainment industry.

title: Engineering, Compliance, and Accountable Innovation Presented by AbbVie

speakers.name: Karyn Quick
speakers.title: Director of IT Quality and Regulatory Compliance

description: Technology transformation is often viewed as a balancing act between speed and control. In reality, the most successful organizations achieve both through strong partnerships between engineering and governance teams. Join AbbVie leaders Sam Spaulding and Karyn Quick as they share how cloud modernization, platform engineering, compliance, risk management, and operational excellence can work together to enable innovation at scale. Attendees will learn practical strategies for breaking down organizational silos, building trusted technology platforms, and creating governance models that support, rather than hinder, transformation.

title: The Practical Technologist's Tech Stack Presented by Capital One
description: While artificial intelligence is transforming what is possible, its true potential is unlocked by the foundation it runs on. This session explores how modern, cloud-native data environments serve as the essential engine powering advanced AI applications. Attendees will discover how to harmonize their broader tech stack with AI initiatives, leveraging strong infrastructure to seamlessly deliver personalized, real-world consumer experiences.

title: Engineering Scalable & Sustainable Infrastructure for the AI Era
locationLabel: Product & Innovation Stage (Exhibit Hall C&D (1st Floor))
description: AI has a power problem. As compute demand explodes, the grid cannot keep up, and the fight for megawatts is colliding with land use and community preservation. Using the 3.3 MWdc Hope Haven Agrivoltaics project as a case study, this session shows how solar energy and AI infrastructure can share the same footprint.

title: Hardening AI-Assisted Development Against Modern Threat Actors

speakers.name: Candice Biamby
speakers.title: Vice President, Product Manager of Cyber Threat Intelligence

description:
AI-assisted development moves fast. Security gaps move faster. Vibe coding enables production in hours, but threat actors are already targeting AI-generated applications for the weaknesses speed creates. This session equips builders with OWASP Top 10 and MITRE ATLAS as practical guardrails, techniques for prompting AI toward secure outputs, and a clear workflow for shipping reliable applications.
Laptops encouraged for demo.

title: Smart Cities Roundtable
description:
The decisions cities make today about infrastructure, energy, technology, and development will shape their communities for decades. This conversation brings together the leaders making those decisions to discuss how they evaluate competing priorities, negotiate with private-sector partners, and determine what communities should receive in return for the investments being made around them.

title: Healthcare Has a User Experience, Too Presented by Genentech

speakers.name: Michael Penn, Jr., MD, PhD
speakers.title: Head of External Engagement, Population Health Center of Excellence

description:
This fireside chat brings health literacy into the everyday lives of the AfroTech audience and asks what a better health user experience could look like.
In a conversation about the intersection of healthcare, technology and user experience, Michael and Davidek explore what healthcare can learn from user-centered design: starting with the needs of the person, identifying friction across the health journey, and making information easier to find, understand and use.

title: Let's Talk for Real
locationLabel: AfroTech Authors Pavilion Presented by Penguin Random House
description: Board-certified OB/GYN and chief medical advisor of Alloy Women's Health, Dr. Sharon Malone, on perimenopause, menopause, sleep, weight, and what to ask your doctor, and why health is the foundation of a long career.

title: AI Edge Meetup Presented by Palo Alto Networks
description: A dynamic networking space where innovators, professionals, and enthusiasts come together to explore the future of artificial intelligence. This meetup will foster community, conversation, and collaboration, connecting attendees with peers and industry leaders to share ideas, insights, and opportunities shaping the AI landscape.

title: Divine Nine Meetup
description: Celebrate the legacy and unity of the NPHC at our Divine Nine Meetup. This gathering brings together members, alumni, and supporters of the Divine Nine fraternities and sororities to connect, share experiences, and strengthen bonds across organizations. This space is to honor the culture, traditions, and impact of Black Greek life while building new relationships and fostering community pride.

title: State of Maternal Health and the Digital Future with Dr. Jessica Shepherd

speakers.name: Dr. Chemen Neal MD, CPCC, FACOG
speakers.title: Vice President Academic Medicine & Strategic Integration, Associate Professor OBGYN
speakers.company: IU Health Medical Group & IU School of Medicine

description: Maternal health is being transformed by digital tools, AI, and telemedicine, but innovation alone does not equal better outcomes. Dr. Jessica Shepherd, Chief Medical Officer at Hers, examines what it will actually take to build maternal care systems that are more accessible, more effective, and more patient-centered, drawing on clinical expertise, health technology, and the responsibility that comes with building care at scale.

title: Longevity Is a Leadership Strategy
locationLabel: AfroTech Authors Pavilion Presented by Penguin Random House
description: A physician and a former CEO on how health, longevity, and staying in the room shape long careers.

title: Build It a Thousand Times
description: Delay is one of the most expensive variables in building infrastructure. Featuring Emiola Banwo, Founder of ProgramHub, and Alexis Cureton, E2 Fellow and Clean Energy Consultant, with Jordan Taylor, CEO of SynergyGrid, moderating, this panel explores how digital twins and digital permitting can improve planning, streamline approvals and reduce costly delays. Alexis brings a clean energy policy and environmental justice perspective on ensuring faster delivery also expands equitable access and community benefit.

title: Scale Smarter: The Tools That Grow With Your Business Presented by Intuit
description:
Growth breaks the systems that got you started. Spreadsheets stop keeping up. Manual work eats your week. Decisions slip because you cannot see your numbers.
In this session, we show you how the right tools help entrepreneurs, founders, and small and mid-sized business owners scale. Hear a moderated panel on when to upgrade your tools, what to automate first, and the next step as your business grows (including Intuit Enterprise Suite). Then watch a live demo of AI doing real work: invoicing, categorizing transactions, and answering cash flow questions in plain language.
Every attendee leaves with a unique code to start a trial and test it on your own business.

title: Cloud Control: The Intersection of AI and Aerospace
description: Led by Nimbus Aerospace, one of the few Black-owned aviation and aerospace companies in the world, this panel explores how AI, sustainability, and engineering are converging to reshape flight. From autonomous systems to sustainable aviation fuels to air traffic data infrastructure, attendees get a direct look at where the industry is heading.

title: Is Quantum Going to Kill Cybersecurity as We Know It?

speakers.name: Subhash Kodnad
speakers.title: Senior Vice President, Engineering Network Security

description: Quantum computing is already forcing governments and enterprises to rethink encryption standards they have relied on for decades. This session breaks down which cryptographic systems are most vulnerable, what post-quantum security requires, and what professionals need to understand now. No physics degree required. Built for leaders who want to get ahead of this shift, not just survive it.

title: AI-Powered Imaging: What If Healthcare Had No Limits? Presented by GE HealthCare

speakers.name: Devin Jenkins
speakers.title: Global Markets Commercial IT Business Partner

description: Attendees will explore how AI, software, and advanced imaging technologies are improving image quality, accelerating workflows, extending clinical expertise, and expanding access to care. locationLabel: AfroTech Authors Pavilion Presented by Penguin Random House

title: Franchising as a Vehicle to Help You Build a Legacy Presented by McDonald's
description: Entrepreneurs, executives, and business leaders are constantly evaluating new ways to pursue business ownership, build a lasting legacy, and expand their impact beyond their current careers. In this interactive session, Tiffany Bentham, Franchising Candidate Manager for McDonald’s and a McDonald’s Owner/Operator, will discuss the McDonald’s franchising opportunity and how ownership can open the door to new professional and entrepreneurial possibilities. Attendees will hear firsthand lessons from the Operators' journey, gain insight into the McDonald’s franchising model, and learn what it takes to evaluate, prepare for, and pursue franchise ownership.

title: GovTech Careers, Contracts, and Clearances with Symoné Berry

speakers.name: Symoné Berry
speakers.title: Principal Radar Systems Engineer and Founder

description: Federal tech spending exceeds $100B annually, and despite recent workforce disruptions, government contracts and cleared positions remain among the most stable, highest-paying paths in tech. Symoné “Beez” Berry has 15+ years inside defense and federal systems and built GovTech Con to be the entry point for professionals who want in. She will demystify government contract procurement and clearances and give attendees a real roadmap into this sector.

title: Protect Your Power in the Workplace with Lee Merritt

speakers.name: Lee Merritt
speakers.title: National Civil Rights Attorney & Community Organizer for Landmark Cases | Adjunct Professor at Harvard | Forbes Power 100 Attorney | Congressional Black Caucus Nation Builder | Top 10 Influential Leader |

speakers.title: Independent Journalist with bylines in AfroTech, Madamenoire, Blavity
speakers.company: Host of Black Culture in Motion on aspireTV

description: Lee Merritt has won some of the most consequential civil rights cases in recent American history: Ahmaud Arbery, Botham Jean, Atatiana Jefferson. What he has learned inside those cases is that legal knowledge is one of the most underused tools Black professionals have. This conversation translates federal civil rights law into something you can use in the workplace: how to document, how to build leverage, and how to protect your position in any professional environment.

description: Aaron Russell leads the infrastructure that delivers AI-powered content to billions of users across Meta's global platforms, from edge compute and GPU caching to video optimization at hyperscale. For engineers building AI-powered products, this is the conversation happening one layer below the model: how do you architect systems when AI becomes an infrastructure constraint rather than just a feature? Aaron brings the view from the technical frontier that most engineers will never see up close.

title: Why Detroit Is Right for Innovation Presented by Gilbert Family Foundation
description: Detroit is a city where innovation meets opportunity. With a rich legacy of building industries, a growing community of diverse founders, and a strong network of investors and ecosystem partners, Detroit offers a compelling environment to launch, grow, and scale a business. The city is leveraging its strengths in advanced manufacturing, mobility, technology, and entrepreneurship to create new pathways for innovation and economic growth. This conversation will bring together investors, founders, and ecosystem leaders to share why Detroit is an attractive place to build a company, access resources, develop strategic partnerships, and connect with emerging markets. By highlighting the people, capital, and collaborative ecosystem driving Detroit forward, we will showcase the city as a place where bold ideas can become thriving businesses and create lasting economic opportunity.
